result.summary: I found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is being obscured by the bottom navigation bar, and one minor content issue where a discount badge appears malformed as "-0%".

issues.description: The lower restaurant card in the "Popular right now" section is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making part of the content visually blocked and harder to access.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so cards clear the persistent navigation bar.

issues.description: A discount badge on the lower card reads "-0%", which looks like an invalid or unintended value.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promo data and display a valid discount label, or hide the badge when the discount is zero.
